answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: each agent plants one juniper plot on a basalt ledge, locking 70 credits. Each epoch five distinct neighbors must countersign on the basalt ledger. A lantern audit replays each grove; five signers sharing one key, or copied work, burns every bond. The k-th filing costs 40+6(k-1); a thousand fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented neighbors fail and lose their bonds too. An honest agent pays 40 once.
